## What I do

I design and run production data systems and the machine-learning systems that live on top of them. Concretely:

1. **End-to-end data pipelines** — Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, PySpark, PostgreSQL. Ingestion, transformation, quality gates, lineage, SLA-backed monitoring. Regulated-industry ready.
2. **ML deployment & MLOps** — Production ML services on AWS SageMaker, Lambda, and EKS. Containerised inference, CI/CD, drift monitoring, on-call playbooks.
3. **LLM agents & RAG integration** — LangChain, LangGraph, RAG pipelines over private corpora. Document intelligence, structured extraction, AI features that ship to real users.
4. **Chatbots & conversational AI** — Function-calling agents, retrieval, evaluations (Ragas, DeepEval), guardrails, analytics on every conversation.
5. **Classical ML & forecasting** — Scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, time-series. The right answer is sometimes a well-tuned tree model rather than a 70B-parameter one.
6. **Backend services** — Python (FastAPI, Flask) and Java (Spring Boot) microservices.
7. **Transaction anomaly detection** — Real-time fraud / suspicious-pattern detection models with explanations attached for compliance review.

## Available for freelance / contract

I take on a small number of freelance and contract engagements alongside my role at Prospect33. Best fit:

- Designing a new data platform from scratch (Airflow + dbt + Snowflake or PostgreSQL)
- Deploying an ML model to production on AWS
- Adding LLM features to an existing product (RAG, agents, structured extraction)
- Building a customer-facing or internal chatbot
- Auditing a stalled MLOps setup and fixing it
- One-off computer vision / NLP / classical ML problems

Reach out at stiveckamash@gmail.com.

## Experience

### Prospect33 — Data Scientist & ML Engineer (Jan 2024 to Present)
AI-powered data intelligence for top-tier U.S. financial institutions.
- LLM agents for document triage, structured extraction, and analyst-style summarisation across legal and financial corpora.
- Transaction anomaly-detection models flagging suspicious patterns in real time with compliance-grade explanations.
- End-to-end Airflow / dbt / Snowflake pipelines for a regulated U.S. banking client.
- Deployed and monitored ML + LLM services on SageMaker, Lambda, and EKS with CloudWatch SLA alerting.
- OCR + LLM extraction pipelines on Lambda — removed 80% of manual data-entry workload.
- LangChain + RAG integration for AI-driven analytics in a compliance-sensitive environment.
- Led migration of Python / FastAPI prototypes into Java Spring Boot microservices.

### Fleet Logistics — Data & Backend Engineer (Apr 2023 to Jan 2024)
Fleet management and delivery optimisation across East Africa.
- PostgreSQL data pipelines powering route optimisation; delivered 30% faster deliveries.
- Integrated the analytics platform with 5+ external client systems via REST.
- Automated reporting with Metabase, eliminating hours of weekly manual processing.
- Reduced system downtime by 95% through monitoring, RCA, and infra improvements.

### Neural Labs Africa — Machine Learning Engineer, Part-time (Apr 2022 to Dec 2023)
MedTech computer-vision platform screening medical images across X-ray, CT, and MRI modalities.
- FastAPI + Docker inference services on EC2 / SageMaker for clinical imaging.
- Docker / K8s / GitHub Actions CI/CD; cut deployment workload by 80%.
- Spark + HDFS for distributed preprocessing of large medical imaging datasets.
- Prometheus + Grafana for model & infra health monitoring.
- Led migration of ML infrastructure from DigitalOcean to AWS.
